summary: Nora can make images with OpenAI gpt-image-2 through her own ChatGPT subscription, as a second provider beside xAI.
details: Selected with `[image_gen] provider = "openai_codex"`; xAI stays the default and behaves as before.
`nora openai-codex-login` logs Nora's own ChatGPT account in with a device code and writes the bootstrap token to `.env`; the rotating token is kept in `./state/openai-codex-oauth.json`.
Reference photos work as with xAI, still behind `allow_reference_images`.
A reply that comes back without a picture is reported as unavailable, never as a made image.
limitations: The device login has not been run end to end against OpenAI; `--from-codex-auth` imports a dedicated `codex login` instead.
Size and quality are requests: the host model chooses its own, so a wide picture can come back square.
Losing `./state/openai-codex-oauth.json` means logging in again, because the `.env` token is spent by the first refresh.
